verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches rate limits indirectly. On-demand deployments are documented as having "no hard rate limits" in contrast to serverless, and reserved throughput and a priority service tier are offered as ways to secure capacity. That implies serverless limits exist, but none of their actual values are shown. Missing for 10: documented serverless rate-limit values (RPM/TPM), how limits scale across usage or spend tiers, how to raise limits, and 429 behavior or rate-limit headers.
